answer: Locks are published in knoll, expire in reef, and wharf lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 45 aliases hence needs 155 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3677 identities would post 4357 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
